title: Define Active Text Block Island Runtime State
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository, Checklist target, and Evidence target before editing Editor.
The runtime state enables visible typing UI, WYSIWYG behavior, or direct canvas input binding.
The runtime state treats a browser-local draft as canonical document truth.
The runtime state bypasses the text-block authoring boundary, Backend mutation request shape, Backend revision gate, Core mutation result, or Editor stale-gated runtime apply path.
The runtime state allows commit while IME composition is active.
The runtime state discards a newer local draft after an older Backend rejection.
Focused or full Editor gates fail after the runtime state is added.
Cleanup side effects leave Core, Backend, Editor, or Project Control dirty or unverified.
verificationTarget: Editor defines tested memory-only active text-block island runtime state that opens one active text block at a time, tracks local draft revision and IME state, builds a Core-validated Backend rich-inline replacement request only through the authoring boundary, and preserves newer local drafts after stale rejection without enabling visible text input.
summary: Done: Editor commit 24219dc0d6e5ec79368c82b159b37e3f9a0b9ed5 defines the memory-only active text-block island runtime state in code and docs, passes focused and full Editor gates on worktree and main, and leaves visible typing UI, WYSIWYG behavior, and broad frontend readiness unpromoted.
